name: Suntory Sui Gin
production: Blend incorporating three steeped liquors (yuzu, green tea, ginger) with eight traditional gin botanicals
history: 2020 | Launched in Japan on 10 March 2020 at MSRP 1,380 yen before tax
palate: Green tea: subtle astringency and umami
expressions: SUI Gin Soda (RTD can) | ready-to-drink gin soda, incl. limited Yuzu & Ginger
serve_official: Gin & soda for meals (Suntory markets it as a mealtime gin soda / 'gin sonic' rather than G&T)
notes: Distillery not named in sources. Second gin from the producer of Roku.
